correctness.rationale: For S_n every ideal (A,B) is either (A,∅), (N\{i},{i}) or (N,B), B nonempty. Compute rowmotion from minimal missing elements: explicit single 3-cycle, n disjoint 5-cycles, and paired complementary subsets in two distinct families of 2-cycles. For n≥4 each 2-cycle family has 2^(n−1)−n−1 cycles; total 2^n−2n−2, all ideal counts sum to 2^(n+1)+n−1. Rank-sums give mean n for 3/5-cycles and n/2 versus 3n/2 for two-cycles. At n=3 there are no two-cycles and order 15, for n≥4 order 30. Independently enumerated all ideals and cycle rank profiles n=3..9, not used for all-n proof.
